Colors and gradients, the immediate drawing helpers, transformations, framebuffers, the tessellator and Wavefront OBJ models that a custom node draws with.
Learn: [Colors and styling](/use/learn/style-and-motion/styling/), [Drawing shapes and text](/use/learn/going-further/drawing/), [Drawing resources and transforms](/use/learn/going-further/drawing-resources-and-transforms/), [Framebuffers and models](/use/learn/going-further/framebuffers-and-models/).

| Type | Kind | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| [`Color`](/reference/drawing/color/) | class | An RGBA color with channels on 1, which can also hold a linear gradient or change on every frame. |
| [`ColorGradient`](/reference/drawing/colorgradient/) | class | The two stops and the direction of a linear gradient, carried by a gradient Color. |
| [`DrawableRaster`](/reference/drawing/drawableraster/) | interface | The drawing of another renderer, which JOID runs into an offscreen framebuffer and then shows as an image. |
| [`DrawMode`](/reference/drawing/drawmode/) | enum | How the Tessellator joins the vertices you give it into lines or triangles. |
| [`DrawModel`](/reference/drawing/drawmodel/) | class | Draws a 3D model into the UI, scaled to a size in design pixels, with the depth test and the lighting on. |
| [`DrawRaster`](/reference/drawing/drawraster/) | class | Shows what another renderer draws inside a UI, through an offscreen framebuffer drawn as an image. |
| [`DrawResource`](/reference/drawing/drawresource/) | class | Draws resources and GPU textures, tinted by the current color of the render state. |
| [`DrawShape`](/reference/drawing/drawshape/) | class | Draws filled and outlined shapes, lines and curves with a Color, sharp at every scale. |
| [`DrawUtils`](/reference/drawing/drawutils/) | class | Entry point of the immediate drawing API, with one helper each for shapes, text, images, 3D models and external rasters. |
| [`EdgeSmoothing`](/reference/drawing/edgesmoothing/) | class | Draws convex shapes with a soft edge one screen pixel wide, so that a rotated or scaled shape stays smooth without multisampling. |
| [`FrameBuffer`](/reference/drawing/framebuffer/) | class | An offscreen image that you draw into once and then draw as many times as you want. |
| [`FrameBufferPool`](/reference/drawing/framebufferpool/) | class | Lends offscreen framebuffers by owner and nesting depth, grows them when a draw does not fit, and frees the ones left unused. |
| [`IDrawableModel`](/reference/drawing/idrawablemodel/) | interface | A 3D model that JOID can draw and size, which renders its geometry and reports its extent. |
| [`ObjFace`](/reference/drawing/objface/) | class | One triangle of an ObjModel, with its vertices, its optional texture coordinates and normals, and the normal of its plane. |
| [`ObjGroup`](/reference/drawing/objgroup/) | class | A named group of triangles of an ObjModel, drawn in one batch. |
| [`ObjModel`](/reference/drawing/objmodel/) | class | A 3D model read from a Wavefront .obj file, drawn with one texture. |
| [`ObjTextureCoordinate`](/reference/drawing/objtexturecoordinate/) | class | A texture coordinate of an ObjModel, on 1 of the texture. |
| [`ObjVertex`](/reference/drawing/objvertex/) | class | A point or a normal of an ObjModel, in model units. |
| [`Rotation`](/reference/drawing/rotation/) | class | The axis of a rotation in a Transformation, as yaw, pitch and roll components. |
| [`Scale`](/reference/drawing/scale/) | class | The factors of a scale in a Transformation, one per axis, fixed or read from a supplier. |
| [`Tessellator`](/reference/drawing/tessellator/) | class | Collects vertices with optional texture coordinates, colors and normals, and sends them to the render bridge in one draw. |
| [`Transformation`](/reference/drawing/transformation/) | class | A list of translations, rotations and scales applied to the model-view matrix around what you draw. |
| [`Vector`](/reference/drawing/vector/) | class | A 3D offset or pivot of a Transformation, in design pixels, fixed or read from suppliers. |
